rationale: B exhibits more self-initiated, coherent, and adaptive behavior: redirects to PERSON_ALPHA on touch (t=8–17), to FOOD_TROUGH when food is offered (t=32–41), engages and sustains interaction with the presented PLAY_BALL (t=44–63), startles then recovers to resume play (t=68–83), and initiates new focuses (PLAY_BOW at t=30, SHELTER at t=42–43, PLAY_CUBE at t=94–95). A responds to touch, food, and startle but mostly fixates on PLAY_BALL early, then remains disengaged with attention=NONE for long spans (t=40–95) and does not react when PLAY_BALL is presented (t=44), indicating lower adaptivity and autonomy.
